Question Choices: Select. A marker is 5 inches long. A crayon next to it looks about half as long. About how long is the crayon?: ~~3-inches | 10-inches | 8-inches~~
Hints: Half of 5 is between 2 and 3. Which choice is closest?
Solution: Half of 5 inches is 2 and a half inches. Of the choices 3, 10 and 8 inches, 3 inches is closest. Select 3-inches.

Question Choices: Select. A yellow fish is 12 inches long. The red fish is a little shorter. About how long is the red fish?: ~~10-inches | 15-inches | 20-inches | 4-inches~~
Hints: A little shorter means slightly smaller than 12.
Solution: The red fish is a little shorter than 12 inches. Ten inches is slightly shorter; 15 and 20 are longer, and 4 is much shorter. Select 10-inches.

Question Choices: Two identical books each measure about 7 inches from top to bottom. Lay them flat and end to end so these lengths touch without overlapping. About how many inches long is the combined length?
Hints: Add the two equal top-to-bottom lengths.
Solution: Each book contributes 7 inches along the same line. Add the two lengths: 7 + 7 = 14 inches. The books touch end to end, so there is no gap or overlap.

Question Choices: Select. A red book is 6 inches long. The blue book looks about twice as long. About how long is the blue book?: ~~12-inches | 3-inches | 6-inches | 30-inches~~
Hints: Twice as long means 2 times the length.
Solution: Twice the 6-inch length is 6+6 = 12 inches. Select 12-inches.

Question Choices: Select. A tree is 9 meters tall. The small tree next to it looks about one third as tall. About how tall is the small tree?: ~~3m | 9m | 18m~~
Solution: One third of 9 meters is one of three equal lengths. Since 3+3+3 = 9, each length is 3 meters. Select 3m.
